saw_lines: Nobody buys an e-bike on impulse. Riders compare motors, frame and whether it arrives ready to ride, then they buy once.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a rider decides if this brand is worth a second look.
Your 10 of 25 copy ads open on the same gravel line, so test three new openers from your own range, such as the Kalkhoff commute and the Mondraker SLY.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: 10 of 25 copy ads open on the same gravel line, so most buyers hear one pitch. Run three new openers from your own range, such as the Kalkhoff commute and the Mondraker SLY, and test each against the gravel story.

One exact copy runs in 10 of 25 ads, so the same pitch repeats to the same people and wears thin. Keep the body copy but change the opening line and creative in each of the 10 ads, using three product photos.

None of your 29 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer weighing a major purchase has nothing concrete to hold onto. Pull one real figure, such as a review count or bikes shipped, and open the next batch with it.
0 of 25 ads mention an offer, so a new buyer sees no reason to act today. Add a first-order offer or bundle, such as an accessory pack on the Kalkhoff Entice 3 LTD, and open three new ads with it.

ads_1: Paid creative led by commuting and trail openers, tested against the gravel story
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
